name: Ellie Collins
source: Inventor, mechanic and engineer to be, Ellie, nicknamed as “Tinker” by students is the famous president of Arlington’s robotics club! Despite being in a male-dominated field, Ellie is not afraid to shine. She loves meeting new people and has a cute, cheerful exterior that charms her potential clients. She’s also fiercely competitive and has a troublemaking side to her that only friends get to truly witness.
